meta.source: MLB Stats API season pitching splits
meta.def_adjustment: Statcast team defense (FRV (player-aggregated)), allocated by BIP share
meta.method: Two-pole WAR: FIP-based pole (~fWAR philosophy) and RA9-based pole with a bWAR-style team-defense adjustment (war_ra9_adj; war_ra9 is unadjusted). Both poles are park-adjusted (static PPF table) and use FanGraphs' exact per-pitcher dynamic runs-per-win and replacement structure (0.12/0.03 wins per 9, SP/RP). Not modeled: opponent quality, reliever leverage, infield flies. WAR at any blend = lerp(war_fip, war_ra9_adj, lambda).
